item.title: The Odyssey and Spider-Man propel record-breaking summer box office worldwide
item.description: The biggest May to September of all time was recorded in US cinemas, with the UK enjoying a 56% rise in audiences, outstripped by an 88% lift in the Middle East and Africa As well as celebrating their wedding, the actors Tom Holland and Zendaya have something else to toast: their two summer blockbusters – The Odyssey and Spider-Man: Brand New Day – have officially made box office history. item.description: En un mercado energético cada vez más incierto , el poder está cambiando de manos. Como cuenta Marc Español en El País , no hace tanto que en el Mediterráneo oriental se libraba una contienda sobre los yacimientos de gas natural de la zona. item.description: While clearing debris to protect ancient Egyptian tombs from flash floods, researchers near Luxor stumbled upon an unknown 3,000-year-old tomb. item.title: US midterms: Trump touts $5,000 payout if Republicans win
item.description: President Donald Trump capped the first day of his Republican Party's ​first-ever midterm convention by proposing to pay every US adult a $5,000 "Trump dividend" if his party wins November's congressional elections. Trump delivered the extraordinary overture during a primetime speech that lasted nearly two hours and firmly placed him at the center of the midterm campaign at a time when his sagging approval ratings could weigh on Republicans' chances.
